_readme: Public catalogue categories (owner ruling 2026-10-21): exactly Preparation, Washing, Cooking, Ventilation, Storage and Refrigeration (Ventilation holds the range hoods only: owner ruling 2026-10-28). "products" maps every published product id to one of them; "excludedProducts" lists the other non-equipment items of the master (id -> reason) that are NOT published. Products in the master categories fresh_air_system, gas_line and fire_suppression are excluded in scripts/build-catalogue.js (EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES) and need no entry here. exhaust_system is NOT excluded any more (owner ruling 2026-10-28): its seven range hoods are published in Ventilation (the hood family), and every other exhaust_system product (ducting, blowers, switches, the install line, the filter block and the lighting case) is listed under excludedProducts with its reason. scripts/build-catalogue.js refuses a master product that is in none of these places, so a new product forces an explicit decision. The private master is never edited. Owner ruling 2026-10-21 (b): in Preparation, Washing and Storage the public catalogue shows ONLY the configurable products (the cards come from scripts/public-families.json), so every other specialised table, stand, sink, washing item, cabinet, shelf, rack, trolley and bin of those categories is listed under excludedProducts with that reason (the master and the Quote Builder are untouched); equipment that is not one of the six types stays a fixed item, in its natural category (the meat grinder and slicer are in Cooking).
